author: Calvin
text:
Stress Test New Access Control Cluster
## Objective

Conduct a stress test on the new access control cluster to evaluate its load-handling capability and verify its stability under different traffic levels.

## Test Scope

* Tool: k6
* Target API: Open API - Search Availability (`/channel/ota/v2.0/hotels/availability`)
* Purpose: Validate the performance and scalability of the new access control cluster under increasing request loads.

## Test Scenarios

Run stress tests with the following request rates:

* 500 requests/second
* 2,000 requests/second
* 5,000 requests/second
* 7,000 requests/second
* 10,000 requests/second

## Verification Items

* Response time
* Error rate
* Timeout occurrences
* Access control cluster performance and stability
* Resource utilization (CPU, memory, network)
* Any bottlenecks observed during the tests

author: Joseph
text:
Define SOP - SQL Script Validation Before Production Execution for development team
**Title**  
Define SOP – SQL Script Validation and Approval Process Before Production Execution

---

## Description

Create a standardized **SOP (Standard Operating Procedure)** for validating, reviewing, testing, approving, and executing SQL scripts before they are run against Production databases.

The SOP should minimize the risk of service disruption, performance degradation, data corruption, and operational incidents caused by manual SQL execution.

---

## Objective

* Establish a mandatory SQL validation process before Production execution
* Reduce risk of database incidents and unexpected system impact
* Improve traceability, accountability, and auditability
* Standardize approval and deployment procedures across the development team

---

## Scope

### In Scope

* SQL scripts executed against Production databases
* Data correction scripts
* Data migration scripts
* Maintenance scripts
* Batch update/delete operations
* Schema changes requiring manual execution

### Out of Scope

* Application-generated SQL
* Automated deployment migrations already covered by CI/CD controls
* Non-production environments

---

## SOP Requirements

### 1. Change Management Requirements

Before execution, every SQL script must have:

* Jira ticket
* Business justification
* Risk assessment
* Rollback plan
* Impact analysis

---

### 2. Source Control Requirements

All SQL scripts must:

* Be stored in Git repository
* Be committed and reviewed through Pull Request
* Be merged into the approved branch before execution

---

### 3. SQL Review Requirements

Mandatory review includes:

* SQL logic validation
* Performance impact review
* Index utilization review
* Locking impact assessment
* Data volume analysis

Recommended:

* AI-assisted SQL review (Claude / approved tool)
* DBA review for high-risk changes

Evidence required:

* SQL review result attached to PR

---

### 4. Testing Requirements

Before Production execution:

* Execute on Staging environment
* Validate expected results
* Validate execution duration
* Validate rollback procedure

Evidence required:

* Staging execution screenshot/log
* Query result validation
* Monitoring screenshot (if applicable)

---

## Deliverables

* SQL Execution SOP document
* Approval workflow
* SQL Review Checklist
* Execution Templates

---

## Acceptance Criteria

**AC1**  
SOP document completed and published

**AC3**  
Required evidence checklist established

**AC4**  
Risk classification and escalation rules documented

**AC5**  
Development team trained and informed of the new process

---

## Definition of Done

* SOP documented
* Review checklist created
* Approval workflow follow Git Strategy
* Team review completed
* SOP published and communicated

text:
Empty V.Comm Rate (%) is mishandled: generic "Failed to save" on all 3 tabs; Combined silently auto-fills 25%
### Pre-condition

* Environment: **DEV**
* Hotel **1001908**, Contract **Shared Rate 111974:1**, Base Rate **20%**, plan 890921
* User is on the **Period-Based V.Comm Rate Override** modal (Configure Override)

### Steps to reproduce

**Case A — generic save failure (all 3 tabs):**

1. Open Configure Override on any tab: **Booking-Based**, **Stay-Based**, or **Combined** (any logic).
2. Add a Booking Tier / Stay Season but leave **V.Comm Rate (%)** empty.
3. Click **Apply Changes**.

**Case B — silent 25% default (Combined tab only):**

1. Open Configure Override → **Combined** tab.
2. Add a Booking Tier / Stay Season, leave **V.Comm Rate (%)** empty → **Save**.
3. Reopen Configure Override.

### Actual

* **Case A:** Alert **"Failed to save V.Comm Rate Override. Please try again."**. No inline validation / red border on the empty field; on Combined the Cross-Reference Matrix shows **Final Rate = 0%** and the Annual Calendar shows `null%` for every month.

![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=a0fe1aac-784a-4a41-b427-c0761b2d5dc0&&collection=&height=791&occurrenceKey=null&width=1856&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
* **Case B:** the empty V.Comm Rate (%) is **silently auto-filled with 25%** on reopen (tied to the Combined rate-cap default). Booking-Based / Stay-Based standalone tabs do NOT do this (no rate cap there).

![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=c00f22cc-aab8-4a63-8f01-7ffb05d03f93&&collection=&height=1032&occurrenceKey=null&width=1920&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
![](blob:https://media.staging.atl-paas.net/?type=file&localId=null&id=90e20978-1ef9-413f-8e79-82aa0dac3f4a&&collection=&height=1032&occurrenceKey=null&width=1920&__contextId=null&__displayType=null&__external=false&__fileMimeType=null&__fileName=null&__fileSize=null&__mediaTraceId=null&url=null)
### Expected

* Empty comm_rate (all tabs/modes) → inline E-VCR-001 “Commission rate must be between 0% and 50%” + no API call (TS-024 pattern).
* NO generic alert (A), NO auto-fill to 25% (B), NO null%/Final 0%.
